facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; individuals can receive foreign money into a foreign-currency bank account.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: licensed banks open foreign-currency accounts for individuals.
facts.P3_local_gateways: VNPAY, MoMo, OnePay and Ngân Lượng are licensed; individual sign-up isn't confirmed.
facts.L1_registration: Usually register a household business; low-income service providers may be exempt by province.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your 12-digit personal ID number is your tax code since July 2025.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: No income tax or VAT on business revenue up to VND 1 billion a year.
facts.L4_vat_gst: Services exported to foreign clients are 0% VAT with a contract and bank payment.
facts.L5_data_protection: Personal Data Protection Law 91/2025, in force since 1 January 2026.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: E-Commerce Law (from July 2026): sellers must verify identity and show return policies.
facts.L7_incentives: Tax-free up to VND 1 billion revenue a year, among the highest thresholds we've found.
facts.D1_id_document: Căn cước card, with your 12-digit personal ID number.

watch_out.text: Old articles say VND 500 million; the threshold is VND 1 billion from 2026.
0% VAT needs a contract with the foreign client and non-cash payment.
Above VND 1 billion revenue you must issue e-invoices.
